failures.triage_note: mark_styles_rtl() in includes/class-plugin.php:702 calls wp_style_add_data($handle,'rtl','replace') for every registered 'listora-*'/'wb-listora-*' handle unconditionally, including 'listora-theme-bridge', without checking whether an RTL companion file actually exists on disk. None of the 3 theme-bridge files (assets/css/themes/{buddyx,buddyx-pro,reign}.css) has an -rtl.css twin. Every RTL-locale pageview on a site using any of these 3 bridges issues a request for a file that does not exist. Not release-blocking on its own (the page still renders correctly RTL via the base variables/components/base RTL stylesheets, which DO exist and DO have twins) but it is a real, reproducible 404 shipped in 1.5.0-era code, caught only because cross-cutting check 1 (console errors) was run on an RTL page — a check most walks skip for non-default locales.
failures.expected: Every stylesheet WP core tries to load an RTL twin for either has that twin on disk, or is excluded from mark_styles_rtl()'s blanket wp_style_add_data() call.
failures.actual: GET /wp-content/plugins/wb-listora/assets/css/themes/buddyx-pro-rtl.css returns 404. Confirmed via the browser's own Network panel (not curl) with dir="rtl" lang="ar" active on http://wb-listora.local/listings/ — every other RTL-suffixed stylesheet on the same page-load (listora-variables-rtl, listora-components-rtl, listora-base-rtl, pro-frontend-rtl, quick-view-rtl, blocks/listing-card/style-rtl) returned 200; only the theme-bridge twin is missing. Page itself still renders RTL correctly (body dir=rtl, search bar direction=rtl) because the base RTL stylesheets carry the mirroring — the bridge file only carries theme-token remapping, so the customer-visible symptom is limited to a wasted 404 network request, not a broken layout.
failures.evidence: browser_console_messages showed 1 error: 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found) @ .../assets/css/themes/buddyx-pro-rtl.css?ver=1.5.0'. browser_network_requests confirmed the 404 status code directly (not inferred from console text) and confirmed the sibling RTL files all returned 200 on the same load. ls on assets/css/themes/ confirms only buddyx.css, buddyx-pro.css, reign.css exist — no *-rtl.css siblings for any of the three. grep confirms mark_styles_rtl() (includes/class-plugin.php:702-711) applies wp_style_add_data(..., 'rtl', 'replace') to every listora-*/wb-listora-* handle with no file_exists() guard, unlike the file_exists() guard already present for the base bridge file itself just above it.
